'''Shadow Squadron''' was a [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Shadow Squadron was charged with protecting a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] with an Imperial fleet.
